name: Genius Gila
notes: 181-byte report descriptor of the mouse interface of a real Genius Gila, recorded with hid-recorder on Linux: https://github.com/bentiss/hid-devices/blob/547829228561cf4ee613b8ad5dee0244f6b61a8c/events/mouse/kye_0458_0138_0.hid#L1-L1. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
